_why: Vulnerable packages that npm audit reports but that never run in the app users get. Each entry is re-checked by scripts/security-scan.mjs: the built bundle must not contain the marker strings.

@grpc/grpc-js.reason: Node-only gRPC transport of Firestore. The app does not use Firestore; the browser bundle only includes firebase/app, firebase/auth and firebase/database.

@firebase/firestore.reason: Not imported anywhere (the app uses Realtime Database). Flagged only because it depends on @grpc/grpc-js.

@firebase/firestore-compat.reason: Not imported anywhere. Flagged only because it depends on @firebase/firestore.

firebase.reason: Umbrella package; flagged only through the Firestore packages above, which are tree-shaken out.
